name: Microsoft Intune & Entra ID MCP Server
description: A comprehensive MCP server that manages Microsoft Intune and Entra ID via the Microsoft Graph API. It exposes 134 tools across 16 categories, enabling AI assistants to perform device and user management, security configuration, policy enforcement, and rich reporting. Features include remote actions (sync, restart, lock, wipe, retire), device inventory, Autopilot management, conditional access, app and group management, and bulk operations.
author: Sujin Nelladath

securityCheck.aiSummary: No security issues detected. Code appears safe for an Intune management tool.
